status: Early read: the desk watches the first 45 minutes and decides at 10:00

prediction.headline: NIFTY is more likely to rise than fall today

why: NIFTY is at 25,728, up 379 points (+1.49%) from yesterday's close of 25,350.
This morning it opened 309 points higher than yesterday's close and has risen 70 points since.

India VIX, the market's 'fear gauge', is 16.9 (down 4% since yesterday: traders expect smaller moves than before). That points to a normal, lively market: NIFTY could move about 271 points up or down over the whole day.
Big news for the whole market today: Tata Steel dips 7% as APL Apollo plunge on ₹28,000 cr deal; Hindalco under pressure.
Also: our forecast team's view is neutral and the morning news brief reads the mood as mixed.
The desk follows the move since this morning's open, which is rising, so it expects more of the same today.
plan: At 10:00 the desk buys two contracts on NIFTY for this week: a call, which makes money if NIFTY rises, and a put, which makes money if it falls. A big enough move either way pays more than the two cost together. It tilts the pair toward a rise, so a rise pays more than a fall. It takes profit at +50%, cuts the loss at -35%, and closes everything by 15:15. All trades are on paper.
